subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should both workspace identity loading and explicit --identity-file imports permanently enforce the existing 2 MiB workspace bootstrap limit?
rationale: The shared limit is architecturally consistent and prevents OOM, but explicit imports previously had no limit, so accepting 2 MiB as a public CLI boundary requires maintainer ownership rather than an automated assumption.

options.title: Approve shared 2 MiB boundary
options.body: Keep the current implementation and accept that larger explicit imports fail, after the contributor posts exact-head CLI proof of the diagnostic.

options.title: Choose an identity-specific limit
options.body: Set and document a separately approved identity import ceiling if maintainers need compatibility beyond the existing bootstrap limit.

options.title: Limit workspace loading only
options.body: Retain the OOM fix for automatic workspace reads but leave explicit imports unchanged, accepting that the CLI path remains unbounded.

recommendation.title: Approve shared 2 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the current implementation and accept that larger explicit imports fail, after the contributor posts exact-head CLI proof of the diagnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: @samzong is the strongest available history signal for the current IDENTITY.md create/update contract affected by this new boundary.
